summary: Magnachip Semiconductor filed an 8-K reporting a privately negotiated Stock Purchase Agreement with Navitas Semiconductor, dated September 18, 2026. Magnachip will issue 1,461,988 common shares at $3.42 per share for $5.0 million gross proceeds in a Regulation D private placement, with closing expected on or about September 24, 2026, subject to customary conditions. The company must file a Form S-3 resale registration statement within 30 days post-closing, targeting effectiveness within 60-90 days. No board recommendation or advisor was named. This is a routine unregistered equity issuance, not a special situation.
